-- Get like-for-like stores (open in both Q3 periods)
WITH lfl_stores AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.store_id
  FROM dim_store s
  WHERE s.store_id < 900
    AND (s.open_date IS NULL OR s.open_date <= DATE '2024-10-28')
    AND (s.close_date IS NULL OR s.close_date >= DATE '2026-01-25')
),
q3_2024_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    s.region,
    SUM(f.net_amount) as net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
    AND d.fiscal_quarter = 3
    AND f.channel_code = 'ST'
    AND s.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM lfl_stores)
  GROUP BY s.region
),
q3_2025_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    s.region,
    SUM(f.net_amount) as net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
    AND d.fiscal_quarter = 3
    AND f.channel_code = 'ST'
    AND s.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM lfl_stores)
  GROUP BY s.region
)
SELECT 
  COALESCE(a.region, b.region) as region,
  a.net_sales as q3_2024_sales,
  b.net_sales as q3_2025_sales,
  CASE WHEN a.net_sales > 0 THEN ROUND(((b.net_sales - a.net_sales) / a.net_sales * 100), 2) ELSE NULL END as lfl_growth_pct
FROM q3_2024_sales a
FULL OUTER JOIN q3_2025_sales b ON a.region = b.region
ORDER BY region

-- Identify like-for-like stores for calendar Q3 comparison (2024 vs 2025)
WITH lfl_stores AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.store_id
  FROM dim_store s
  WHERE s.store_id < 900
    AND (s.open_date IS NULL OR s.open_date < DATE '2024-07-01')
    AND (s.close_date IS NULL OR s.close_date > DATE '2025-09-30')
),
q3_2024_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    s.region,
    s.store_id,
    SUM(f.net_amount) as net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE d.calendar_year = 2024
    AND d.calendar_month IN (7, 8, 9)
    AND f.channel_code = 'ST'
    AND s.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM lfl_stores)

),
q3_2025_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    s.region,
    s.store_id,
    SUM(f.net_amount) as net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE d.calendar_year = 2025
    AND d.calendar_month IN (7, 8, 9)
    AND f.channel_code = 'ST'
    AND s.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM lfl_stores)

),
regional_sales AS (

    COALESCE(a.region, b.region) as region,
    SUM(a.net_sales) as q3_2024_sales,

)

    JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
    WHERE d.calendar_year = 2024 
      AND d.calendar_month IN (7, 8, 9)
      AND f.channel_code = 'ST' 
      AND s.store_id < 900
  ) a
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT f.store_key, s.store_id, s.region
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
    JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
    WHERE d.calendar_year = 2025 
      AND d.calendar_month IN (7, 8, 9)
      AND f.channel_code = 'ST' 
      AND s.store_id < 900
  ) b ON a.store_id = b.store_id
  WHERE a.region = b.region
),
q3_2024_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    s.region,
    SUM(f.net_amount) as net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE d.calendar_year = 2024 
    AND d.calendar_month IN (7, 8, 9)
    AND f.channel_code = 'ST'
    AND s.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM stores_both_periods)
  GROUP BY s.region
),
q3_2025_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    s.region,
    SUM(f.net_amount) as net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE d.calendar_year = 2025 
    AND d.calendar_month IN (7, 8, 9)
    AND f.channel_code = 'ST'
    AND s.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM stores_both_periods)
  GROUP BY s.region
)
SELECT 
  COALESCE(a.region, b.region) as region,
  ROUND(a.net_sales, 2) as q3_2024_net_sales,
  ROUND(b.net_sales, 2) as q3_2025_net_sales,
  ROUND(((b.net_sales - a.net_sales) / a.net_sales * 100), 2) as lfl_growth_pct
FROM q3_2024_sales a
FULL OUTER JOIN q3_2025_sales b ON a.region = b.region

-- Simplified final result: growth by region
WITH stores_both_periods AS (
  SELECT a.store_id, a.region
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT f.store_key, s.store_id, s.region
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
    JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
    WHERE d.calendar_year = 2024 AND d.calendar_month IN (7, 8, 9)
      AND f.channel_code = 'ST' AND s.store_id < 900

    JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date

      AND f.channel_code = 'ST' AND s.store_id < 900
  ) b ON a.store_id = b.store_id
  WHERE a.region = b.region
),
regional_summary AS (
  SELECT 
    s.region,

  FROM fact_sales_line f

  JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE (d.calendar_year = 2024 OR d.calendar_year = 2025)
    AND d.calendar_month IN (7, 8, 9)
    AND f.channel_code = 'ST'
    AND s.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM stores_both_periods)
  GROUP BY s.region
)
SELECT 
  region,
  ROUND(((sales_2025 - sales_2024) / sales_2024 * 100), 2) as like_for_like_growth_pct
